requiredFindings.title: Other-figure sources are absent from the report’s pin set
requiredFindings.evidence: The report says sm-report-data.json carries every number with its source record and SHA-256 pin. Its24 pins cover the timing-component assembly only. The renderer reads U-4a,U-4b,SM-6 and rust-scope outside that pin mechanism, while Sui scope,census-v2 fixed bytes and U-7 coverage are literal summaries with no report-data pins. There are no corresponding other-figure records in the data JSON.
requiredFindings.impact: The full report cannot be reproduced or checked against a complete pinned source closure as claimed. Accepted component custody does not automatically bind the additional renderer inputs and literal summaries.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Add exact source records and SHA-256 pins for SM-6,SM-8,SM-10,SM-11,SM-12 including Sui,SM-13/14 decomposition,S_eff first-term records and U-7’s matrix. Materialize or explicitly reference those pinned values in report data and render the summaries from them; update the every-number custody claim accordingly. Preserve existing accepted bytes and timing/outcome derivations; no measurement rerun is needed.

requiredFindings.title: Required SM-5 populations and SM-12 peak-memory statistics are not assembled
requiredFindings.evidence: Item9 SM-5 requires inventory rows,total bytes and canonical descriptor bytes against snapshot bounds; report data’s SM-5 component entries carry only timing statistics. The report’s S_eff paragraph gives only selected examples instead of per-row repository/dependency populations and bound standings. Item9 SM-12 requires time and peak memory; its report table gives medians but no maximum times or numeric peak-memory values, and report data contains no SM-12 records. Accepted rust-scope actor records already provide maxNanos and measuredPeakProcessRssBytes (for example Napi host-a3014958ns and25935872bytes).
requiredFindings.impact: The report is incomplete as item9’s measured report even though its F/T arithmetic is correct. A descriptive RSS label and a citation to earlier work do not supply the required measured values and comparisons.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Carry the accepted per-row SM-5 repository/dependency rows or entries,total bytes,descriptor bytes and sourced bound standings, preserving D-9’s separate parts and absent dependency-descriptor bound. Carry accepted SM-12 actor medians,maxima and native/converted whole-process peak RSS for all reported workloads including Sui, with prototype/synthetic labels and later-owned fields still pending. Populate these values in the machine report and render or clearly link a pinned complete table. Do not fabricate worker scratch,bound keys or completion-round values; no rerun is needed.
